tenderSchedule.title: Supply, Repair and servicing of gear box of 125/30T EOT crane and other Connected works
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer TM2 Office RTPS Raichur

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Any changes in minimum labour wages during the contract period will be implemented as per KPCL orders.

technicalCriterionList.description: Minimum financial turnover (civil engineering construction works) not less than two times the annual payments from this contract (Rs. xxxxx Lakhs)
Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 90%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work of value not less than Rs. xxxxxxx (80% of estimated cost of tender)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)

The intending bidder shall have one year experience in the field of Repair/Servicing of gear box & LT wheel of 125T or above capacity EOT Crane in any thermal power plants or process industries and shall have minimum class-II electrical contractor licence issued by competent authority. As a proof, bidder shall upload all relevant documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As a proof, bidder shall upload all relevant documents.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed single/multiple (Maximum 03) similar works of value not less than Rs, 21.43 lakhs during any one of the preceding five years(2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) and shall upload the Work done/ Work completion Certificate/ MOM /PO and corresponding invoice issued by Competent Authority. (Work done of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Bidder shall upload the Work done certificates/ Work Completion certificates issued by competent authority.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder in his name should have achieved minimum average annual financial turnover of Rs, 42.87 lakhs in at least two financial years(2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) during the last five years. As a proof of this the bidder shall upload the certified copy of the Profit and Loss account or Turnover certificate duly certified by the chartered accountant.(Turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Bidder shall upload the certified copy of the Profit and Loss account statement or Turnover certificate duly certified by the Chartered Accountant

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Supply, Repair and servicing of gear box of 125/30T EOT crane and other Connected works

itemList.description:
Dismantling & servicing of main gear box of MH, AH, LT & CT, along with supply and Replacement of oil seal, O ring & minor hardware’s & assembling & oil top-up
Number of Main gear box:
Main Hoist-01Nos
Auxiliary Hoist-01 Nos
Long Travel- 02 Nos
Cross Travel -01 Nos 
One Set = Total 5 gear box.

Dismantling & servicing of planetary gear box of MH, AH, LT & CT, along with supply and replacement replacement of oil seal, O ring & minor hardwares & oil topup.
Number of planetary gear box:
Main Hoist-01Nos
Auxiliary Hoist-01 Nos
Long Travel- 02 Nos
Cross Travel -01 Nos 
One Set = Total 5 gear box.

Repair & reconditioning of existing thrust brakes of gear box of planetary gear box of MH, AH, LT & CT, along with supply and replacement of liners , oil seals & brake oil.
Number of thrust brakes of gear box:
Main Hoist-03Nos
Auxiliary Hoist-03 Nos
Long Travel- 06 Nos
Cros Travel -03 Nos
One Set = Total 15 Thrust Brakes.

Repairs & reconditioning of couplings at motors to  of main gear box and planetary gear box of MH, AH, LT & CT, along with supply and replacement of worn-out or damaged coupling bolts, rubber bushes, carbon bushes etc.Number of Motors:
Main Hoist-02Nos
Auxiliary Hoist-02 Nos
Long Travel- 04 Nos
Cros Travel -02Nos
One Set = Total 10 coupling

Balancening of MH & AH along with alignment of MH, AH gear box, planetary gear box with motor,and inspection and servicing of MH &AH.
Inspection, cleaning of rope drums and wire rope of MH & AH and lubricate with cadmium compound.
Inspection & servicing of bottom block pully of MH & AH.

Inspection & rectification of LT wheels.
Dismantling of the LT Wheels and shifting it to the work Shope for the reconditioning works and Erection and alignments of the Lt wheels after reconditioning-08 Nos of wheels
